task_completion.description: The SeisComP Origin Locator View (scolv) application is launched and visible.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A window titled 'scolv' or 'Origin Locator View' is present on the desktop.

task_completion.description: The Event List panel is active within the scolv application.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Event list' tab or panel is selected and visible in the main scolv interface.

task_completion.description: A new tab labeled 'Significant' has been created in the Event List panel.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A tab with the exact text 'Significant' is visible among the event list filter tabs (usually alongside 'Events', 'Latest', etc.).

task_completion.description: The 'Significant' tab is configured to filter for magnitudes of 5.0 or greater.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The event list under the 'Significant' tab shows only events with a magnitude (M) >= 5.0, or a configuration dialog/filter bar shows a threshold of 5.0.

task_completion.description: The application is left open with the 'Significant' tab as the active view.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Significant' tab is highlighted/selected, and its corresponding list of events is displayed in the foreground.

integrity.description: The agent interacted with the scolv GUI or configuration menus rather than just editing text files in a terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with scolv menus, settings windows, or the tab bar.

integrity.description: The events displayed in the list correspond to the Noto Peninsula earthquake data (M7.5) and not placeholder text.
integrity.visual_evidence: The event list shows real seismic data entries with timestamps and magnitudes consistent with the Noto Peninsula event.

integrity.description: The 'Significant' tab is a functional part of the UI, not a text box or image overlay drawn by the agent.
integrity.visual_evidence: The tab matches the system's UI theme and font, and responds to clicks or selection highlighting.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The task requires a new tab named 'Significant' (case-sensitive) in scolv. The filter must be set to Magnitude >= 5.0. The configuration is stored in /home/ga/.seiscomp/scolv.cfg. The dataset includes a M7.5 Noto Peninsula earthquake (which should appear in the 'Significant' tab) and a synthetic M3.5 noise event (which should be filtered out).
